name: Khura
ingredients: Vegetable oil or butter for frying
instructions: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine the buckwheat flour with water to create a smooth, pourable batter.
2. Add a pinch of salt to the batter and whisk until well combined.
3. Heat a flat pan or tawa over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil or butter.
4. Pour a ladleful of the batter onto the pan and spread it into a thin circular shape.
5. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook the other side until golden brown.
6. Serve hot, traditionally paired with butter tea or a spicy vegetable curry.
description: Khura is a staple pancake dish originating from the Monpa community of the Tawang and West Kameng districts. It holds cultural significance as a simple, nutritious meal often consumed during breakfast or as an accompaniment to butter tea, reflecting the agrarian traditions of the high-altitude regions.
